regions.today: Windy this morning with fresh to strong and gusty westerly winds, along with sunshine and showers. Winds will gradually ease through the afternoon and evening with showers becoming confined to the north of the province. Highest temperatures of 10 to 12 degrees.
regions.tonight: A mostly dry start tonight with isolated showers and clear spells in light to moderate southwesterly winds. Becoming cloudy later with rain and drizzle developing as winds become moderate to fresh southerly. Lowest temperatures of 5 to 8 degrees.
regions.tomorrow: Dull and breezy tomorrow with moderate to fresh and gusty southerly winds, increasing fresh to strong and gusty through the afternoon. Scattered outbreaks of rain and drizzle will ease in the afternoon and evening. Highest temperatures of 15 to 17 degrees.
